items.title: How Manny Pacquiao Controlled Adrien Broner
items.style: Write a natural and engaging English boxing recap. The narration must explain what happens in chronological order and remain grounded in the supplied source material.

source.source_text: Round 1: Pacquiao immediately shows foot mobility and quick footwork, working with the left-handed jab to measure distance. He starts faster and lighter on his feet. Round 2: Both fighters look for positioning with the lead foot. Pacquiao raises the tempo with quick combinations, Broner answers back. The first real tactical exchange of the fight opens up.

segment_topics: Pacquiao establishes distance and controls the opening phase
Pacquiao increases the pressure and forces Broner to defend
